key_facts.text: The FOMC voted to maintain the federal funds target range at 4.25–4.50% on April 30.
This is the fifth consecutive meeting at which the Committee has held rates steady.
The statement removed the prior reference to 'progress toward the Committee's inflation goal'.
Street consensus prior to the meeting priced a 62% probability of a 25-basis-point cut.
Chair Powell signalled the Committee is in 'no hurry' to adjust policy at the press conference.

numeric_facts.context: CME FedWatch implied probability of 25bp cut, evening before

quotes.text: We are in no hurry to adjust the stance of policy.
quotes.speaker: Jerome Powell
